snippet.title: Portabellows - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Portabellows, an exploration wholesome 3D platformer developed by Nance and Phred. Players will spend their retirement years in an island paradise to explore a vibrant island full of pie recipes to find, abilities to acquire, and more. Portabellows is launching in 2026 for PC (Steam).
